title: Pilot Study for Speculum Free Cervical Cancer Screening
official: A Pilot Study Continuation to Assess the Use of an Introducer "Calla" During Cervical Cancer Screening
summary: The objective of the work described in this protocol is to determine the optical signatures of cervical dysplasia using optical technologies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Healthy female

* Aged 21-65 years
* Have had a pelvic exam
* Have conversational proficiency in English
* Highest level of education attained

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Pregnant women
